related_resources.reason: Detailed first-person account of Ningbo family, education, 1969 appointment, children, 1971 sample 191, laboratory conditions, early self-testing and clinical trial, isolation, institutions, and recognition; treat retrospective memory as such.

First-person research reconstruction with supporting project images, extraction details, animal testing, 1972/73 clinical work and plant taxonomy; archival interpretations cross-check independent accounts.
Independent documentary history of Project 523, Tu group, 1971 extraction, colleagues in Yunnan, Shandong, Guangzhou, collective publication and later combination therapy.
Tu interview and contextual history on birth, family, education, Cultural Revolution, 523 group, botanical challenges, 1972 human work and 2011 Lasker recognition.
Author account of pharmacy education, Chinese-medicine training, Ge Hong, antimalarial discovery and later developments; interpret as participant account.
Ningbo, tuberculosis in youth, scientific career and Cultural Revolution context; supplementary institutional biography.
Education, connections with Peking University, early life, Nobel/academic status; use as corroboration not for speculative psychology.
History of 1970s research conditions, botanical extraction, self-testing and chemical process; corroborates Tu autobiography with interviews/history.
Molecular structure, functional peroxide, chemical modifications, formulation limits and the 1970s cooperative research network.
Endoperoxide/heme activation model and mechanistic uncertainty; scientific context, not biographical source.
Characterizes the early Tu/Project 523 self-testing and patient evaluations as promising but uncontrolled research in period context.
Official 2011 award context recognizing Tu and artemisinin.
Award division: one-half to Tu for malaria, one-half jointly to Campbell and Omura for roundworm treatments; work and institutional background.
Role of artemisinin and partner drugs in ACTs; distinction between partial resistance and treatment failure, 2025 known regions and therapy principles.
Recent malaria prevalence, impact and growing resistance; time-sensitive epidemiology, not attribution of benefits to a single invention.
